prompt: After a practice test, you lost marks in several different ways. Which review method is most likely to raise your next score?

options.text: Note the total score and move straight on to new topics
Re-do only the questions you got right, to build confidence
Sort your mistakes into careless slips and concepts you did not understand, then practise the concept gaps
Memorise the correct answers to that exact test

explanation: Different mistakes need different fixes. Sorting them shows which marks were lost to slips and which to real gaps, so your practice time goes on the gaps that cost the most.
